title: Free-build aptitudes
kicker: Power and builds · level up and power
hook: **Twelve aptitudes** — you have **no class**. Points go where you want, at one price.

blindSpots.meaning: One of twelve free-build stats (Might, Fortitude, Vigor, …). Primary dials of a build.
You do not pick Warrior/Mage. Classes exist as Zomboss AI patterns — enemy legibility, not your container.
Force, Finesse, Bastion — regions of build space, not locks that surcharge dabbling.
Changing your mind is allowed and priced when it applies — friction, not a forbidden door.

alsoTrue: In this build, commander-scope spend is live and thin; other scopes and a polished sheet are still ahead.
Allocation can stack across commander, species, variant, and the unique demon — who you are is the sum.

rows: More to lose before you lose

sections.title: How you spend
steps: Earn aptitude points as Dave progresses.
Spend freely across the twelve — no posture gate tax.
sections.note: Exact point costs are on screen / in balance data.

sections.title: What reaches the field
paras: What you allocate at commander scope reaches every demon you field.
Species and specimen layers can add more lean later (species builds still WIP).

doSteps: Confirm you have aptitude points to spend.
Open builds and put points into two aptitudes that match how you want to play.
Field a demon and treat the change as side-wide commander lean.
doNote: Stop when “no class” sticks. WIP lean: [species builds](species-builds).

mixUps.a: None. Free-build only. Enemy “classes” are Zomboss patterns.
No. They describe space; they do not surcharge dabbling.
Commander spend is Shipped thin — fuller scopes still ahead.

mixUps.q: Is this the same as relics?
mixUps.a: No. Aptitudes are free-build stats; relics are gear.
